title: Tabbi edition (formatVersion 1)
description: Sources/TabbiKitCore/Editions/BundledEditions/<id>.json: a branded build of the same app, which changes only its name, bundle id, preselected kit, icon and data folder. Read by Edition.decode(from:) and by scripts/assemble.sh. The file name must equal the id. The app ignores fields it doesn't read; this schema rejects them, since editions are written only in this repository.

formatVersion.description: A build skips editions with a higher formatVersion than it reads.

id.description: Lowercase slug, used by bundle.sh and --edition.

name.description: The app's name and its Application Support folder: not empty, no slash, no leading dot, no surrounding whitespace.

defaultKitID.description: The kit a fresh install starts with.

icon.description: An .icns file name in Resources. Left out keeps AppIcon.icns.

infoPlist.description: Info.plist strings that replace the base plist's. The keys the edition's own fields set are not allowed.
